hero.title: AI receptionist
hero.description: Configure the customer-facing call capability of Pilot — how it answers, books, and hands off to your team.

training.title: Train your assistant
training.description: Give Pilot the business knowledge and boundaries it needs to handle customer calls correctly and confidently.

voice.title: Customize how it talks
voice.description: Set a clear greeting, tone, response length, and custom instructions that match your business.

booking.title: Booking rules
booking.description: Control business hours, appointment duration, availability, buffers, same-day booking, and cancellation policies.

test.title: Test your receptionist
test.description: Call your connected business number from another phone to experience the greeting, questions, and booking flow exactly as a customer would.
